requirements.description: Content: approved intro with 4 highlighted keywords, name yannworks lowercase; no other personal information anywhere in the public repo
Links X, GitHub, Experiments in this order with the given URLs, all working; no /experiments path in this repo
Geist Sans for text, Geist Serif upright for keywords at a size that stands out; woff2 self-hosted with the OFL licence next to them
Minimal precise look: ink, paper and Clawd orange only; one column on phones; none of the banned patterns; the scene is the only big visual
On load, intro and links enter with a staggered fade plus slight rise finished within about 1 s; keywords get one subtle extra touch
Links and buttons react clearly on hover and press; keyboard focus visible
Light and dark themes: default follows the device, toggle switches and remembers, no flash of the wrong theme on load
Theme switch plays a whole-page dither dissolve in the scene's dot pattern in about 0.5 s; cross-fade where unsupported
Favicon is a small Clawd from the clawd skill icon preset

Scene: Clawd in orange from the approved grids and motions, never dithered; everything else 1-bit Bayer dither in ink and paper (black on white light, white on black dark with dimmed house lights); crisp whole-number scaling, no brown palette
Theatre scene: scripted 30 to 60 s loop (enter, piano, typewriter, robot peek and wake, bow, exit) with no visible jump; different from the X banner
One follow-spot glows and flickers through the dither; follows the mouse on a computer, drifts on its own on a phone
Scene pauses off screen and when the tab is hidden, stays light on phones, and shows a still dithered frame without WebGL
Pause/play button for the scene works; canvas has an aria-label describing the scene
Reduced motion: keep blink, small moves in place, glow, shorter dissolve, text fade; remove walking (spot dims and Clawd is at the next prop when it comes back), mouse-following light, text rise
Plain HTML/CSS/JS, no build step, small readable files with tokens as CSS variables at the top and short comments; text and links work without JS
Screenshots at 390 and 1440 px in light and dark, normal and reduced motion; no horizontal scroll and no console errors
Recordings (MP4 or GIF) of the full scene loop and of the theme switch
Text contrast meets WCAG AA in both themes and Clawd orange reads well on both backgrounds
Main decisions noted in .web-craft, public-safe
Design-system board page built from the real tokens and components
After Yann writes publish: site on main and https://yannworks.github.io checked
Poses missing from the clawd library use the closest documented move and keep the body shape; any truly new pose is reported, not drawn
Optional: Geist Serif square dots (ELSH axis) on the keywords if they look good next to the scene
